author: rlancemartin
summary_zh: Anthropic 官方 skills 仓库更新了 claude-api skill：SKILL.md、models.md 和各语言示例的默认模型改为 Claude Opus 5.5（claude-opus-5-5），新增 Claude Sonnet 5.5，并同步更新定价、模型支持说明、各平台可用性和迁移指南。更新还在 shared/evals/ 下加入 build-eval、eval-hillclimb、cost-hillclimb、eval-audit 等评测构建与迭代优化流程，附带报告 schema 和轻量 HTML 报告。这些内容对用 Claude API 开发、做模型迁移和搭建 LLM 评测流程的开发者有直接参考价值。
pin_reason: 官方 skill 随 Claude Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 发布同步更新，含默认模型切换、迁移指南和官方评测与迭代优化流程，长期可参考。

title: Humanize: Judgement Engineering for Agentic Coding
content:
arXiv:2610.08900v2 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic coding makes code generation cheap, but reliable completion remains difficult: the agent that writes the code is a weak judge of whether it is done.
  We present Humanize, a multi-agent orchestration workflow for agentic coding built around judgement engineering: explicit, mechanically enforced decisions at the boundaries between planning, implementation, review, and learning. A human approves a plan contract, a builder agent implements it in rounds, and a reviewer agent from another vendor decides completion; deterministic hooks, not a model, route work between these roles and enforce 72 mechanical gates. Viewed as a Markov chain over repository states, alternating builder and reviewer samples jointly from two models, so a defect survives only if both miss it. We study Humanize through its deployment, 118 public postmortems of real loops, and its applications. Over 68 versions in 108 days, it gathered 1,468 GitHub stars.
  Appli
author: Sihao Liu, Ligeng Zhu, Zijian Zhang, Dongyun Zou, Zhengyang Zhang, Changye Li, Song Bian, Song Han, Tony Nowatzki
summary_zh: 论文提出 Humanize，一个以“判断工程”为核心的智能体编程多智能体编排工作流。流程是：人类审批计划契约，builder 智能体分轮实现，再由另一家厂商的 reviewer 智能体判定是否完成。各角色之间的任务流转由确定性 hooks 而不是模型负责，并强制执行 72 道机械化关卡。论文把这个过程建模为仓库状态上的马尔可夫链，说明两个不同模型交替采样能减少单一模型自评带来的缺陷遗漏。这为解决“写代码的智能体不擅长判断自己是否完成”提供了一套可落地的方法。

title: An Empirical Study of Agent Skills' Downstream Utility
content:
arXiv:2610.08875v2 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agent Skills package procedural guidance and resources for reuse, but a relevant Skill does not necessarily improve task performance. Existing studies characterize Skill content and evaluate downstream performance, yet provide limited explanations of how utility depends on content, execution configuration, and multi-Skill organization. We conduct an empirical study on 87 SkillsBench tasks, defining downstream utility as the pass-rate difference from No-Skill on the same tasks under the same model--harness configuration. We compare the same Skills across nine configurations, then examine alternative published Skills and organizations of fixed Skill sets under three selected configurations. We retrieve marketplace candidates from a curated corpus of 37,596 Skills. LLM-assisted analysis of content, execution traces, and final artifacts, followed by author review, relates provided support to actual use and task outcomes. The same Skills help
author: Yu Cheng, Dehai Zhao, Zhongxin Liu, Qing Huang, Zhenchang Xing, Xiaoxue Ren
summary_zh: 该研究在87个SkillsBench任务上开展实证分析。它把Agent Skills的下游效用定义为：在相同模型与执行框架配置下，相对无Skill时的通过率差值。研究在9种配置下比较同一批Skills，并进一步考察市场中其他已发布Skills的替代效果，以及多Skill组织方式的影响。结论揭示了相关Skill并不必然提升任务表现，可为Claude Code等Agent编写、选择和组合Skills提供实证依据。

title: v2.1.295
content: What's changed Added onFailure: "block" for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through Added Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) support: terminals that implement it can show whether Claude Code is working, waiting on you, or done Added quoted text to the /copy picker, so a drafted message copies without its > markers Added a warning to claude plugin install , enable , disable and marketplace add when the settings file they write to does not load Added a line on stderr, when it is a terminal, that says what a claude -p run is waiting for when it stays open after its last turn Added support for timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms on the Claude apps gateway's Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other cloud upstreams: a value you set now limits how long a stream may take to start there, after which it fails over or gets a 502 Added a "Backgrounding cancelled" message when you stop the turn while ← is waiting f
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.295 为 command 和 HTTP hooks 新增 onFailure: "block" 选项。开启后，hook 无法启动、超时或返回非预期退出码时，会拦截相应操作，不再放行。本版本还支持 Program Status Protocol（OSC 7501），终端可以显示 Claude Code 当前是在运行、等待用户还是已完成。另外，/copy 复制引用文本时会去掉 > 标记，插件安装时会提示配置文件未加载，claude -p 运行未退出时会在 stderr 说明在等待什么，并为云端网关新增 upstream_ttfb_ms 超时设置。

content: Anthropic's offering to help open-source projects track down security vulnerabilities with a new service called OSS Scanner. It says open-source projects that opt-in will get "thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost." That could mean open-source projects get alerted about possible security issues sooner, but the trade-off is that OSS Scanner's […]
author: Stevie Bonifield
summary_zh: Anthropic 推出了一项名为 OSS Scanner 的新服务。主动申请加入的开源项目，可以免费获得由其最强模型定期执行的深度安全扫描。这样项目能更早收到潜在漏洞的提醒，但文章也提到这项服务需要权衡取舍。这是 AI 模型能力在代码安全审计上的一次新落地。

title: Agent Plasticity: Measuring Self-Improvement Through Experience
content:
arXiv:2610.08902v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: AI agents increasingly operate in environments where they can diagnose failures and improve through experience, yet existing evaluations largely measure what an agent can do at a fixed point in time rather than how effectively it learns. Evaluating self-improvement requires answering three questions: does future performance improve and generalize beyond the interactions that enabled learning; how efficiently are new capabilities acquired; and where does the self-improvement process break down? To answer these questions, we study self-improvement in a controlled setting where agents amortize past experience into reusable artifacts that are inherited by future instances. At each checkpoint, we measure performance on training and held-out environment interactions while accounting for learning cost. We introduce agent plasticity, the efficiency with which an agent converts experience into gains in future held-out performance. Across multiple
author: Harman Singh, Anton Bakhtin, Rulin Shao, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ilia Kulikov, Rob Fergus, Sanjeev Arora, Kurt Keutzer, Jason Weston, Anuj Mahajan, Anirudh Goyal
summary_zh: 论文提出“Agent Plasticity”评估框架，衡量 AI Agent 能否通过经验自我改进，而不只是看某个时间点的能力。实验中，Agent 把过往经验沉淀成可复用的产物，供后续实例继承。研究在各检查点同时测量训练环境和留出环境的表现，用来回答三个问题：提升能否泛化、新能力获取的效率如何、自我改进在哪里失效。这对设计 Agent 记忆、技能沉淀和 CLAUDE.md 这类经验积累机制有参考价值。

title: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
content: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.
summary_zh: LegalOn 按任务匹配 Astra、Sol、Luna 三种模型，并有策略地管理预算，在开发速度不变的情况下，把 Codex 预计日成本降低了 65%。这是一个企业控制 AI 编程工具成本的实际案例，模型分级路由和预算管理的做法可供参考。不过原文篇幅很短，没有给出具体的实施细节。

title: v2.1.294
content: What's changed Fixed prompt and agent hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block Improved how prompt hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.294 修复了以自然语言指令形式编写的 prompt hook 和 agent hook（如「Block commands that...」）未能拦截应拦截操作的问题。同时改进了 Stop 和 SubagentStop 上指令式 prompt hook（如「构建失败时继续」）的判定，减少 Claude 过早停止的情况。对依赖 hooks 做安全拦截或流程控制的用户较为实用。

title: Sequential Probabilistic Uncertainty Estimation for Parallel Multi-Agent Reasoning Systems
content:
arXiv:2610.08901v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have attracted growing attention for improving reasoning through interaction among multiple agents. In this work, we focus on parallel multi-agent reasoning systems, where several agents solve the same problem over multiple rounds and aggregate their outputs into a final answer. Despite their strong reasoning performance, uncertainty estimation for such systems remains underexplored: the reliability of a MAS depends not only on individual generations, but also on how agents interact and evolve across rounds. We propose SAUCE (Sequential Agent Uncertainty through Consensus Evolution), a lightweight, training-free uncertainty estimator that formulates MAS uncertainty as sequential inference over a latent system-level belief. SAUCE aggregates round-level agreement and generation-uncertainty signals through a filtering-style update. Across five backbones, five benchmarks, and two MAS protocols, SAUCE impro
author: Tunyu Zhang, Zihao Zhao, Yusong Zhao, Haizhou Shi, Zhuohang Li, Haoxian Chen, Hao Wang, Dimitris N. Metaxas
summary_zh: 论文提出 SAUCE，一种无需训练的轻量级方法，用于估计并行多智能体推理系统的不确定性。在这类系统中，多个智能体分多轮求解同一问题，最后聚合答案。SAUCE 把系统不确定性建模为对潜在状态的序列推断，通过追踪各轮之间智能体共识的变化来判断结果是否可靠。这项研究对多 Agent 编排和并行采样投票等 LLM 工作流有一定参考价值，但离 Claude Code 的实际使用还比较远。

title: Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station
content:
arXiv:2610.08927v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent AI systems have made rapid progress in scientific discovery when given well-defined metrics, but whether they can autonomously undertake open-ended scientific discovery remains unclear. We investigate AI's ability to tackle open-ended tasks in Station, an open-world environment in which multiple agents simulate a scientific ecosystem. To tackle challenges specific to open-ended tasks, we propose augmenting Station with two mechanisms: a Supervisor mechanism and periodic Meta Reflection, which encourage persistent exploration even when intermediate metrics are lacking. We construct open-ended tasks from three recent oral papers presented at ICLR. We give agents the main research question studied in each paper while withholding the paper's results and disabling web access. We then measure how many of the original findings-partitioned into individual criteria-agents rediscover. We find that Station rediscovers 62.7% of the criteria o
author: Wenyu Du, Stephen Chung
summary_zh: 该论文在多智能体开放世界环境 Station 中，研究 AI 智能体能否在缺少明确评估指标时自主完成开放式科学发现。作者为 Station 增加了监督者（Supervisor）机制和定期元反思（Meta Reflection）机制，让智能体在缺少中间指标时也能持续探索。实验基于三篇 ICLR 口头报告论文，只给智能体论文的研究问题、不给论文内容。这些机制设计对构建长时间运行的自主智能体工作流有一定参考价值。

title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
content: Across recruiting, engineering, and operations, Oracle turns specialist knowledge into fast, repeatable workflows with ChatGPT Work and Codex.
summary_zh: OpenAI 官方案例，介绍 Oracle 在招聘、工程和运营团队中用 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 把专家知识做成快速、可重复的工作流，部分任务从几天缩短到几分钟。文章偏企业宣传，可以参考 AI 编程助手在企业规模化落地的思路，但给出的原文摘要较短，具体技术细节和可复用的方法有限。
